name: competitorlens-pipeline
description: Sprint 1 + Sprint 2 + Sprint 3 assertions: crawl, extract, analyze, generate, validate, diff-report, ux-patterns stages

assertions.assertion: crawl_url returns dict with 'html' key when FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is missing
assertions.notes: Should return error dict, not raise exception

assertions.assertion: crawl_url returns error dict when FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is empty string
assertions.notes: Graceful error — error key present in response

assertions.assertion: crawl_url output includes keys: url, html, markdown, screenshot, metadata, crawled_at
crawled_at field is a valid ISO 8601 timestamp string
assertions.notes: Datetime format: ends with Z or +00:00

assertions.assertion: crawl_url returns error when HTML length < 100 chars
extract_blueprint returns error when crawl_result has empty html and markdown
extract_blueprint output contains all required ComponentBlueprint fields
assertions.notes: Fields: sections, navigation, filters, dataDisplayPatterns, ctaPlacement, layoutType

assertions.assertion: extract_blueprint sets url field from crawl_result
extract_blueprint auto-detects competitor=PropertyOnion for propertyonion.com URLs
extract_blueprint sets extractedAt to a valid ISO 8601 timestamp
CLIProxyAPI failure triggers fallback to DeepSeek direct API
assertions.notes: Retry logic: proxy first, then direct

assertions.assertion: extract_blueprint returns error dict (not exception) when both LLM backends fail
_truncate_html_for_llm returns string <= max_chars
_truncate_html_for_llm prefers markdown over HTML when markdown length > 500
competitor_analyses table has required columns: id, competitor_name, source_url, component_type, layout_skeleton, brand_guard_status
ux_pattern_library table has required columns: id, pattern_name, source_competitor, description, reuse_count
competitor_analyses has RLS enabled
assertions.notes: ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

assertions.assertion: ux_pattern_library has RLS enabled
assertions.notes: ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

assertions.assertion: save_analysis returns error dict when SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY is not set
list_analyses returns empty list when SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY is not set
_detect_competitor returns 'PropertyOnion' for propertyonion.com URL
_detect_competitor returns 'Foreclosure.com' for foreclosure.com URL
_detect_competitor returns 'Unknown' for unrecognized URLs
_validate_blueprint returns non-empty list when required fields missing
_validate_blueprint returns empty list when all required fields present
validate_report returns non-empty list when required fields missing
validate_report returns empty list when all required fields present
analyze_blueprint returns error dict for empty blueprint input
analyze_blueprint returns error dict when blueprint has error key
extract_patterns_for_library returns list type
assertions.notes: Even for empty or minimal report

assertions.assertion: _strip_markdown_fences removes ```jsx ... ``` wrappers from JSX
assertions.notes: LLMs often wrap output in markdown fences

assertions.assertion: _validate_jsx_structure returns valid=False when export default missing
assertions.notes: Missing export default is a critical JSX issue

assertions.assertion: _component_name_from_report returns 'AuctionCalendar' for calendar component type
generate_jsx returns error dict for empty report input
validate_jsx returns PASS for brand-compliant JSX content
assertions.notes: Navy + Orange + bg#020617 + Inter + hooks = PASS

assertions.assertion: validate_jsx returns BLOCK for JSX containing purple color violation
validate_jsx returns BLOCK for empty JSX content
AuctionCalendar.jsx passes BrandGuard with score >= 90
assertions.notes: First real output must pass BrandGuard target

assertions.assertion: BrandGuard detects missing navy (#1E3A5F) as violation
AuctionCalendar.jsx earns at least 4 bonus feature points
assertions.notes: ML score, BID/REVIEW/SKIP, lien, max bid = 4 minimum

assertions.assertion: validate_file returns BLOCK status when file does not exist
BrandGuard detects missing Supabase integration as violation
